messages:
rachel (finance): Mariner Systems hasn't applied payment for INV-2026-558 ($18,750) due 2026-02-28. AP says remittance was delayed because PO MS-3342 didn't match. Can AE confirm status?

tom (acct-exec): I emailed Maria at AP. They asked us to confirm the PO number in the invoice header; I resent corrected invoice with PO MS-3342 baked in. Asked for ETA on funds.

maria (Mariner Systems): Thanks - we saw updated invoice. Bank queue shows ACH today but won't post until EOD because of batch cutoffs. We can send remittance pdf as proof now.

rachel (finance): Remittance pdf is fine. If you can post it here (mask account numbers) we'll avoid placing a temporary service hold. Otherwise hold starts 2026-03-02 00:00 UTC.

maria (Mariner Systems): Uploading remittance (masked): "REMIT: ACH - ****6789 - INV-2026-558 / PO MS-3342 - AMT $18,750". Bank confirmation ID: BC12345. Posting expected today 18:15 UTC.

tom (acct-exec): Got it. Thanks for the remittance. I'll ask finance to accept the proof and waive the standard late fee as a one-time courtesy.

olivia (legal): Quick reminder: per contract, we can assess a 1.5% late fee monthly. Approving one-time waiver is OK if collections approves and we add note to account. Make sure waiver is documented.

payments-bot: Payment status for INV-2026-558: pending ACH settlement. Run `/payments refresh 2154321000` to check post.

rachel (finance): Confirm receipt of remittance. We'll mark the account pending settlement and hold off on suspension. Tom - please send the waiver note and I'll close this once funds settle.

tom (acct-exec): Will do, sending waiver note now and cc'ing legal.

maria (Mariner Systems): Thanks everyone. We'll confirm once funds are visible on our bank statement too and reply here.

rachel (finance): Closing the thread pending settlement. If payment fails to post by 2026-03-03 EOD we'll reopen and trigger follow-up. :white_check_mark:
